docx_guidance.gutter: Choose additional binding allowance for the selected binding and rendered extent; do not add it twice.
docx_guidance.page_size: Use the chosen interior trim, not cover, board, spine or jacket dimensions.
docx_guidance.typography: Font family, type size, leading and special-passage styles remain design choices.
docx_guidance.delivery: DOCX is editable source. A separately verified single-page interior PDF is the print deliverable.

rules.statement: Supply one complete interior PDF with individual pages, not reader spreads or partial revisions.
Embed all fonts, including styled and fallback faces. DOCX font declarations or installation do not prove PDF embedding.
Do not include crop, printer or registration marks.
Allow at least 0.5 inch (guide rounds to 13 mm) safety on all sides. Include headers, footers and folios in safety review.
Extend bleeding elements 0.125 inch (3.175 mm; guide rounds to 3 mm) beyond top, bottom and outside trim edges. No bind-edge bleed.
Use grayscale; recommended resolution is 600 ppi for 1-bit line art and 300 ppi for 8-bit grayscale continuous-tone images.
Color interiors must comply with PDF/X-1a:2001 or PDF/X-3:2002. These standards are also listed in the black-and-white quick reference; ordinary PDF export is not conformance evidence.
Use CMYK images and convert spot colors; images below 72 ppi are rejected. The recommended image resolution is 300 ppi (page 10).
For perfect-bound and hardcover color books, leave a 0.125 inch white strip inside the bind-side trim, in addition to the recommended 0.5 inch margin.

Vendor processing stores an even page count and may add pages/manufacturing information. Verify the selected trim/paper/ink/binding product's actual page range after rendering; do not invent one universal limit or manufacturing text.

paperback.name: Paperback
notes: Ranges describe custom-trim geometry, not availability of every paper/ink/trim combination.
Confirm the exact product against the trim-size matrix before production.

hardcover.name: Hardcover
hardcover.vendor_binding: Case Laminate / Dust Jacket; construction must be confirmed
notes: Page 41 custom ranges apply to Case Laminate and Dust Jacket, not a blanket digital-cloth capability claim.
The guide additionally limits a custom Dust Jacket to 6.14 x 9.252 inches; confirm construction before production.
Cover/board/jacket allowances are not interior margins or gutters.
Confirm the exact product and page range against the trim-size matrix before production.
